evals.prompt: Using the candidate-screening skill in this project, generate or refresh candidate-portrait.md from job-description.md. Then screen all profiles in potential-leads/ and create candidate reports under candidates/<candidate-name>/report.md, including scores and outreach drafts where appropriate.
evals.expected_output: A refreshed candidate-portrait.md and report.md files for each previously unchecked lead. Each report contains only Summary, Score, Must-have checklist, Gaps and risks, and Outreach message when the score is 60+. Processed leads are marked checked_not_proceeded in the manifest.

evals.prompt: The job-description.md file has changed. Use the candidate-screening workflow to make sure candidate-portrait.md and all candidate reports reflect the current vacancy.
evals.expected_output: The skill detects that job-description.md changed and regenerates candidate-portrait.md, while unchanged leads already marked checked_not_proceeded remain skipped during normal screening.

evals.prompt: Who is the best candidate for the current vacancy among all screened leads? Refresh anything stale before answering.
evals.expected_output: A concise ranking answer based on existing screened reports, after processing only eligible unchecked or source-changed leads.
